routeRoster.derivedFrom: Honua.Server.EndpointRegistry.All, via the generated feature catalog (tests/dotnet/Honua.Architecture.Tests/FeatureCatalog/FeatureCatalogGenerator.cs).
routeRoster.normalization: A served route is normalized to its Esri-relative operation path by stripping route constraints ({layerId:int} -> {layerId}) and dropping the service-instance address: under /rest/services/, every segment before the first segment ending in 'Server' is the address of a service instance, not part of the operation's identity. /rest/services/Utilities/Geometry/GeometryServer/clip and /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/exportImage therefore normalize to /GeometryServer/clip and /ImageServer/exportImage. /sharing/rest/* and the catalog roots /rest/info and /rest/services carry no service address and normalize to themselves. The HTTP method is not part of the key, so the GET and POST forms of one Esri operation are one operation carrying one judgement; honuaEndpoints lists every served METHOD /path behind it.
routeRoster.note: esriPaths, honuaEndpoints, and capabilityMaturity on every served operation below are DERIVED and must not be hand-edited. capabilityMaturity is the ADR-0058 capability tier (is this route in the release?), NOT the parity status (how much of Esri's behaviour does it support?) — a stub operation on an in-release route correctly reads status=stub, capabilityMaturity=[implemented]. Only status, name, notes, and the prose fields are authored, in docs/gis/data/geoservices-parity-judgment.json. Regenerate with scripts/generate-geoservices-parity.sh.

honuaExtensions.name: Temporal Extent (Honua extension)
honuaExtensions.notes: Returns the resolved start/end time field names plus the layer's deterministic min/max timestamps as ISO 8601 UTC and Unix epoch milliseconds. Companion to the GeoServices REST timeInfo block on layer metadata. Returns 404 when the layer is not configured as time-aware (no timeInfo); returns 200 with null min/max when the layer is time-aware but has no rows. Output cached under the LayerMetadata tag and shares its invalidation. JSON only (f=json|pjson); other formats return 400. Community-tier (ADR-0024); see docs/gis/temporal-animation-api.md.

honuaExtensions.name: Query Clusters (Honua extension)
honuaExtensions.notes: DBSCAN or K-Means clustering. algorithm defaults to 'dbscan' when omitted. eps is meters (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxDbscanEpsMeters); algorithm-specific required parameters are validated. returnHullPerCluster=true returns one feature per cluster (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxClusters) with clusterId and featureCount; default returns one row per source feature with objectId, nested attributes, geometry, and clusterId. outStatistics requires returnHullPerCluster=true; per-feature cluster assignments cannot carry aggregate columns and return HTTP 400 if both are supplied. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null in per-feature mode, populated in hull mode). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Bounded by Limits.Analytics.MaxInputFeatures. Requires the active analytics.clustering entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required with the GeoServices error envelope and an entitlement remediation message. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

honuaExtensions.name: Spatial Join (Honua extension)
honuaExtensions.notes: Joins target layer against joinLayerId (must differ) using predicate intersects/contains/within/dwithin. dwithin requires positive distance in meters (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxDWithinDistanceMeters). Each target feature preserves objectId, nested attributes, and geometry while adding matchCount; carryFields is a comma-separated list and is emitted as arrays of matched join-layer values, while outStatistics aggregates over matched rows. The join layer is resolved through the same IResourceValidator access policy as the target. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null for this operation's maxOutputRows). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Requires the active analytics.spatial-join entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

honuaExtensions.name: Query Buffer Aggregate (Honua extension)
honuaExtensions.notes: Buffers each feature by distance in unit (meters/kilometers/feet/miles). The Limits.Analytics.MaxBufferDistanceMeters cap is enforced after unit conversion so it cannot be bypassed by switching to a larger unit. dissolve=true (default) unions overlapping buffers per group via ST_Union and returns dissolved polygons with featureCount plus any group/stat columns; dissolve=false returns one row per input feature with buffered geometry and objectId. groupByFields and outStatistics follow the standard GeoServices statistics shape. outStatistics requires dissolve=true; per-feature output (dissolve=false) cannot carry aggregate columns and returns HTTP 400. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null for this operation's maxOutputRows). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Requires the active analytics.buffer-aggregate entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

honuaExtensions.name: Query Density (Honua extension)
honuaExtensions.notes: Hex or square grid binning over Web Mercator. cellSize is meters and is clamped to [Limits.Analytics.MinDensityCellSizeMeters, Limits.Analytics.MaxDensityCellSizeMeters]. Output rows include cellId and featureCount; optional weightField adds a weighted sum column named weight. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows. FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Output bounded by Limits.Analytics.MaxDensityCells. Requires the active analytics.density entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

honuaExtensions.name: Query H3 (Honua extension)
honuaExtensions.notes: Aggregates features into H3 hexagonal grid cells at a configurable resolution and returns per-cell aggregate statistics. No Esri equivalent.

layerQuery.name: where
layerQuery.notes: ArcGIS SQL parser. Operators: =, <>, >, >=, <, <=, AND/OR/NOT, IS [NOT] NULL, [NOT] LIKE, [NOT] IN, [NOT] BETWEEN, arithmetic (+, -, *, /, %). Functions: string (UPPER, LOWER, LENGTH, CHAR_LENGTH, TRIM/LTRIM/RTRIM, SUBSTRING comma-form and SQL-standard SUBSTRING(x FROM s [FOR n]), SUBSTR, REPLACE, CONCAT, POSITION(sub IN str)), math (ABS, CEIL/CEILING, FLOOR, ROUND, POWER, MOD, SQRT, trig), date/time (CURRENT_DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIME, NOW, YEAR/MONTH/DAY/HOUR/MINUTE/SECOND and the SQL-standard EXTRACT(field FROM source) for those fields), type conversion CAST(value AS type) over an allowlisted type set, and #date#/DATE '...'/TIMESTAMP '...' literals. All values are parameterized; no client SQL is interpolated. Re-deferred: CASE WHEN/THEN/ELSE/END expressions, LIKE ... ESCAPE custom escape chars, EXTRACT fields outside YEAR..SECOND (WEEK/QUARTER/DOW/EPOCH), and subqueries (no AST nodes in the shared filter pipeline).

Supports GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage, and GetCoverage over the primary raster with image/tiff, image/png, image/jpeg, SUBSET/BBOX spatial trim, SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS, optional OUTPUTCRS, RANGESUBSET band selection (band1..bandN, comma list and band1:bandN intervals), the full Scaling extension (SCALESIZE explicit per-axis sizing x(w),y(h); SCALEFACTOR uniform factor; SCALEAXES per-axis factors x(f),y(f); SCALEEXTENT per-axis grid intervals x(low,high),y(low,high) - at most one scaling operator per request, resolved against the subset-trimmed base grid), and phenomenonTime temporal subsetting (SUBSET=phenomenonTime("instant") or ("start","end"); the request must intersect the coverage acquisition time, else InvalidSubsetting). Capabilities advertise native CRSs for visible coverages; one-axis SUBSET is native-CRS only. The range-subsetting and scaling extension conformance classes are not advertised pending CITE validation. Multidimensional slicing beyond phenomenonTime, NetCDF, XML POST, and WCS-specific mosaic selection are deferred.

partial.name: WMTS
partial.notes: OGC WMTS 1.0 GetCapabilities/GetTile facade over the ImageServer tile/cloud-cache pipeline. Supports KVP and RESTful resources, WebMercatorQuad matrices, STYLE=default, image/png + image/jpeg + image/tiff tiles, GetFeatureInfo (application/json/text/xml) returning the pixel band values at the requested tile pixel, and a TIME dimension for temporal layers (GetTile/GetFeatureInfo honour a TIME parameter). Non-WebMercator tile matrix sets are deferred.

partial.name: Calculate Volume
partial.notes: Computes cut/fill volumes and 2D surface area per area-of-interest polygon against the layer associated DEM (raster_sensor_metadata.dem_source), integrating (elevation - basePlane) * pixelArea over DEM pixels in the AOI through the shared clip primitive. Partial: only a constant base plane is supported, the AOI is bounded by a per-operation pixel budget (over-budget returns 400), and a raster with no modeled DEM returns 501 rather than a fabricated value (ADR-0065).

partial.name: Compute Cache Info
partial.notes: Dynamic ImageServer layers return a spec-shaped cacheInfo object with the service extent and intentionally omit tileInfo/cacheType until a formal Esri-style raster tile cache is configured. The loose-object tile GET cache is operational storage, not advertised cache metadata.

partial.name: Compute Class Statistics
partial.notes: Computes per-class signatures over the classDescriptions training AOIs: pixel count, per-band mean vector, per-band min/max/stddev, and the band-by-band sample covariance matrix (n-1), over a single raster or a layer mosaic (rasterIds + mosaicRule) with an optional bandIds subset. Partial: bounded by a configurable per-class pixel budget (GeoServices:ImageServer:ClassStatistics:MaxPixelsPerClass) and renderingRule/multidimensionalDefinition are rejected with 501 because signatures are computed on source pixels.

partial.name: Compute Histograms
partial.notes: Returns per-band histograms without the parallel statistics array. Supports the same rasterIds, bandIds, mosaicRule, time, and histogramParameters.size selection path as computeStatisticsHistograms; An AOI geometry clips the analysis to that area (envelope-scoped); renderingRule execution remains deferred.

partial.name: Compute Pixel Location
partial.notes: Converts point geometries to raster pixel column/row coordinates using the raster geotransform, falling back to the raster extent when no affine transform is present. Supports rasterId and input spatial references when the shared CRS transform service is available.

partial.name: Compute Statistics and Histograms
partial.notes: Returns per-band statistics ({min,max,mean,standardDeviation,count}) and per-band histograms ({size,min,max,counts[]}). Supports rasterIds (CSV/JSON array of catalog object IDs; defaults to the selected layer mosaic), the Honua-extension bandIds selector (1-based), mosaicRule, single-instant time filtering to the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch, and histogramParameters.size (default 256, capped at 1024). The parallel statistics[] and histograms[] arrays are aligned positionally: index i on both sides describes the same band. Multiple rasterIds are appended in request order. A band is only dropped from both arrays when neither the statistics nor the histograms result contained an entry for it; when a band is present on only one side, the missing side is zero-filled (an all-zero BandStatistic, or a BandHistogram with empty counts[]) so the parallel arrays stay index-aligned. An AOI geometry/geometryType clips the analysis to that area (envelope-scoped) for both single rasters and mosaics; without a geometry the full selected raster or mosaic is analysed. Stretch, Colormap, and Clip renderingRule chains are applied; ExtractBand, BandArithmetic, and pixelSize remain deferred.

partial.name: Compute Tie Points
partial.notes: Returns the raster pre-registered control points / GCPs from its sensor metadata, passed through verbatim and bounded to 10000 points per response. Partial by design: automatic feature detection / descriptor matching (how ArcGIS derives tie points) needs a computer-vision dependency this repository bars, so a raster with no modeled control points returns 501 rather than a fabricated result (ADR-0065).

partial.name: conf.json (tile-cache configuration)
partial.notes: Interop route, not Esri's tile-cache configuration document: it returns the ImageServer service descriptor. Honua's ImageServer is dynamic, so no fused cache is advertised by default (singleFusedMapCache/tileInfo are emitted only when the opt-in ImageServerTileMetadataOptions flag is set). It exists because the ArcGIS Maps SDK for .NET native runtime probes conf.json while loading an ImageServiceRaster and treats a 404 as fatal (#1456, #1648).

partial.name: Estimate Export Tiles Size
partial.notes: Estimates bounded WebMercatorQuad tile archive size; reports tilePackage/storageFormat for both ZIP and Esri exploded-cache TPK (storageFormat=tpk).

partial.name: Export Image
partial.notes: Default response is a JSON envelope with a temporary href; f=image streams the rendered bytes inline with the format-specific media type.

partial.name: Export Tiles
partial.notes: Exports bounded WebMercatorQuad image tiles to configured cloud file storage (local, S3, Azure Blob). storageFormat=zip (default) writes a flat {z}/{x}/{y}.ext ZIP and storageFormat=tpk (or tilePackage=true) writes an Esri exploded-cache TPK (v101/<cache>/_alllayers + conf.xml/conf.cdi); both are synchronous. Compact Cache V2 / TPKX (storageFormatType=esriMapCacheStorageModeCompactV2, or storageFormat=tpkx/compact/compactv2) submits a durable asynchronous job and returns the ArcGIS { jobId, jobStatus } envelope; the package is a real Esri TPKX 1.0 archive of Compact Cache V2 .bundle files. It requires the durable tile-export job runtime (an execution job store); when that is unavailable the request is rejected rather than silently downgraded.

partial.name: Find
partial.notes: Finds raster catalog images whose footprints contain toGeometry. Supports objectIds, where, inSR, fromGeometry validation, and maxCount. Results return catalog id/name, acquisition date, center, pixel size, rows, and cols; Esri camera/orientation-ranked image selection is deferred until sensor metadata is modeled.

partial.name: Get Samples
partial.notes: Samples pixel values at point, multipoint, polyline/polygon vertex, or envelope-center locations using the shared raster identify pipeline. sampleCount is capped at 1000.

partial.name: Identify
partial.notes: Point/envelope/polygon identify with JSON responses. A renderingRule renders the sampled pixel (post clip/stretch/colormap); raw source values are returned otherwise.

partial.name: Legend
partial.notes: Returns Esri-shaped layers[].legend[] swatches as base64 PNGs (image/png). Renders a 5-class equal-interval ramp keyed off the resolved layer mosaic's band-1 statistics by default; a renderingRule with an explicit Colormap is honoured (one swatch per colour stop). Per-layer renderer persistence and non-colormap renderer overrides are not yet honoured. Only f=json/f=pjson is accepted.

partial.name: Measure
partial.notes: Implements Basic map-space point, distance/azimuth, area/perimeter, and centroid mensuration over point, envelope, and polygon Esri JSON. Sensor/DEM-backed height and 3D operations return 501 until sensor/orientation metadata is modeled.

partial.name: Project
partial.notes: Reprojects Esri JSON geometry arrays between supported spatial references via the shared CRS projection pipeline and returns the Image Service geometries[] response shape. Envelope geometries remain envelope-shaped. datumTransformation is honored: a client-supplied geotransformation WKID (or composite geoTransforms) is resolved through the shared Esri WKID -> PROJ pipeline catalog and applied via 3-argument ST_Transform, matching the Geometry Service; an unknown/inapplicable WKID returns 400. The image-coordinate-system transformation parameter is still rejected with 400 until neutral support is added.

partial.name: Query
partial.notes: Returns Esri-compatible raster catalog features (OBJECTID, footprint polygon, MinPS/MaxPS/LowPS/HighPS/CenterX/CenterY/ZOrder/Shape_Length/Shape_Area/BandCount/PixelType/AcquisitionDate/CreatedAt). Supports where (parsed via the GeoServices SQL filter parser, applied in-memory; max 2000 chars), objectIds, outFields projection, orderByFields, an envelope-intersects spatial filter, outSR (footprint rings and the aggregate extent are reprojected when a transform is available), single-instant time filtering to the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch, resultOffset, resultRecordCount (default 100, capped at 1000), and the returnGeometry/returnIdsOnly/returnCountOnly/returnExtentOnly shaping flags. Spatial WHERE pushdown to the database, pixelSize, and non-envelope geometry/spatialRel predicates are not yet honoured.

partial.name: Query Boundary
partial.notes: Returns the aggregate raster footprint boundary as Esri shape plus approximate area. The boundary is extent/footprint based; NoData-trimmed single-raster boundaries are deferred.

partial.name: Raster item image support data
partial.notes: Returns the Esri-shaped imageSupportData (sensor name, camera model, and interior/exterior/RPC orientation presence flags plus DEM source) projected from the raster sensor-metadata companion. Partial: only rasters with a modeled sensor-metadata row carry support data; a plain COG reports not-available rather than a fabricated empty support-data document.

stub.name: Raster item source file
stub.notes: Route exists and resolves the raster item, then returns a precise capability-honest not-available response: Honua stores raster pixels in the provider (PostGIS raster / analytic stores) rather than referencing a downloadable source file, so there is no file to stream. Never a fabricated payload.

exportImage.name: bbox, imageSR, bboxSR, interpolation, compressionQuality
exportImage.notes: CRS inputs for `imageSR` and `bboxSR` accept numeric WKID, `EPSG:####`, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms (`[EPSG:####]`), and `CRS84` aliases. compressionQuality is validated to 0-100 and maps to JPEG QUALITY or TIFF JPEG_QUALITY when applicable.

exportImage.name: format
exportImage.notes: Supports png, jpg, jpeg, tif, and tiff.

exportImage.name: f
exportImage.notes: Supports json, pjson, and image. f=image returns rendered bytes inline with the format-specific media type; html is not supported.

exportImage.name: size
exportImage.notes: Accepts Esri-style width,height dimensions from 1,1 through 4096,4096; omitted values default to 400,400.

exportImage.name: compression
exportImage.notes: Applied to TIFF output only. Supports None, JPEG, and LZ77; LZ77 maps to GDAL DEFLATE. Ignored for non-TIFF outputs.

exportImage.name: renderingRule
exportImage.notes: Executes a Stretch (MinMax/StandardDeviation/PercentClip, optional per-band Statistics), a Colormap (explicit [value,r,g,b] stops or a named ColorrampName), and a Clip (envelope/polygon, including ClippingType=1 keep-outside). Identity / StretchType=0 are no-ops. Unrecognized stretch/colorramp variants and inline Colorramp objects return 501; unknown functions return 400. Chain planning/validation is internal (there is no computeClass route): the planner walks Identity / Stretch / Colormap / Clip / ExtractBand nodes (max chain depth 8) and rejects unknown functions with a 400 naming the offending node. Output pixel type defaults to U8 when the chain includes Stretch and F32 otherwise, unless the document overrides outputPixelType.

exportImage.name: mosaicRule, time
exportImage.notes: mosaicRule accepts merge-strategy tokens or an Esri-style JSON object and is applied when multiple rasters intersect the request. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp, then applies the export bbox/window.

exportImage.name: multidimensionalDefinition
exportImage.notes: Registered Zarr coverages support a bounded native-CRS grayscale PNG slice for GET/POST numeric and service-name routes. Requires one coordinate per selected dimension, format=png, and RSP_NearestNeighbor; JPEG/TIFF, reprojection, advanced interpolation, renderingRule, bandIds, noData, time, and mosaicRule combinations are rejected explicitly and tracked by #2717.

identify.name: geometry, sr, returnCatalogItems
identify.notes: `sr` accepts numeric WKID, `EPSG:####`, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms (`[EPSG:####]`), and `CRS84` aliases.

identify.name: f
identify.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

identify.name: mosaicRule, time
identify.notes: mosaicRule is applied when the identify point intersects multiple rasters. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp, then applies the identify point.

identify.name: renderingRule
identify.notes: When supplied, identify returns the rendered pixel value (post clip/stretch/colormap, matching exportImage) instead of the raw source value; omitting it preserves the raw-value contract. Executes the same Stretch (MinMax/StandardDeviation/PercentClip), Colormap (explicit stops or named ColorrampName), and Clip (envelope/polygon, including ClippingType=1 keep-outside) support as exportImage; unsupported chains return 400/501.

tile.name: mosaicRule, time
tile.notes: mosaicRule is applied when multiple rasters overlap the requested tile. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp, then applies the tile envelope.

query.name: where
query.notes: Parsed via the shared GeoServices SQL filter parser and applied in-memory against catalog metadata fields (OBJECTID, Name, MinPS, MaxPS, LowPS, HighPS, CenterX, CenterY, ZOrder, Shape_Length, Shape_Area, BandCount, PixelType, AcquisitionDate, CreatedAt). Limited to 2000 characters; spatial WHERE pushdown is not yet supported.

query.name: objectIds
query.notes: Accepts CSV (1,3,5) or JSON array ([1,3,5]) form.

query.name: outSR
query.notes: Stamped onto the response spatialReference. Footprint geometry is NOT reprojected â€” clients must inspect each feature's geometry-level spatialReference to detect that the rings remain in the raster's native SRID.

query.name: resultOffset, resultRecordCount
query.notes: resultOffset defaults to 0; resultRecordCount defaults to 100 and is capped at 1000. Sets exceededTransferLimit when the page is truncated.

query.name: returnGeometry, returnIdsOnly, returnCountOnly, returnExtentOnly
query.notes: returnExtentOnly emits the aggregate extent computed after where/objectIds filtering and before pagination.

query.name: f
query.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

query.name: geometry, geometryType, inSR, spatialRel, outFields, orderByFields, pixelSize
query.notes: Spatial filtering against arbitrary client geometries, per-field projection, ordering, and pixel-size hints are not yet honoured.

query.name: time
query.notes: Accepts a single ISO 8601 instant and filters the catalog to rasters in the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement.

computeStatisticsHistograms.name: rasterIds
computeStatisticsHistograms.notes: Accepts CSV (1,3) or JSON array ([1,3]) of catalog object IDs. When omitted, defaults to the selected layer mosaic rather than a single primary raster. Unknown IDs return 400 Bad Request.

computeStatisticsHistograms.name: bandIds
computeStatisticsHistograms.notes: Accepts CSV or JSON array of 1-based band indices. Forwarded to the raster store as the band selector. The caller-supplied order is preserved when aligning the parallel statistics[]/histograms[] arrays.

computeStatisticsHistograms.name: histogramParameters.size
computeStatisticsHistograms.notes: Bin count, capped at 1024. Default is 256 when omitted.

computeStatisticsHistograms.name: f
computeStatisticsHistograms.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

computeStatisticsHistograms.name: mosaicRule, time
computeStatisticsHistograms.notes: mosaicRule is applied when rasterIds is omitted and multiple rasters participate in the selected mosaic. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp before computing statistics/histograms.

computeStatisticsHistograms.name: geometry, geometryType, renderingRule
computeStatisticsHistograms.notes: AOI geometry clips analysis to its envelope. Stretch, Colormap, and Clip renderingRule chains are applied; ExtractBand and BandArithmetic return an explicit not-implemented response.

computeStatisticsHistograms.name: pixelSize
computeStatisticsHistograms.notes: Pixel-size analysis hints are not yet honoured.

legend.name: f
legend.notes: Only json and pjson are supported. Other formats return 400 Bad Request.

legend.name: renderingRule
legend.notes: An explicit Colormap renderingRule produces one legend swatch per colour stop. Other renderer overrides remain deferred; without a Colormap the response uses a 5-class equal-interval ramp keyed off the resolved layer mosaic's band-1 statistics.

wcs.name: GetCapabilities
wcs.notes: Returns WCS 2.0.1 XML with OWS service metadata, operations metadata, WCS service metadata, Contents coverage summaries, and ServiceMetadata crs:crsSupported advertisement values (in the xs:any Extension slot) covering each visible coverage's native CRS plus the default WGS84/WebMercator identifiers the CRS registry can resolve. The advertisement is additive: no CRS-extension conformance class is declared, so the document stays valid for the WCS core ETS. ACCEPTVERSIONS, ACCEPTFORMATS, and SECTIONS are validated.

wcs.name: DescribeCoverage
wcs.notes: Accepts repeated or comma-separated bare integer COVERAGEID values and returns GML 3.2 bounds/grid metadata plus gmlcov rangeType band metadata.

wcs.name: GetCoverage
wcs.notes: Accepts exactly one bare integer COVERAGEID. Supports image/tiff, image/png, image/jpeg, SUBSET/BBOX spatial trim, SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS, and OUTPUTCRS over the primary raster (each client-supplied CRS is validated against the coverage's advertised transformable set; a parseable but non-transformable value returns 400 OutputCrs-NotSupported or SubsettingCrs-NotSupported per OGC 11-053r1 rather than a downstream error), plus RANGESUBSET band selection, the Scaling extension (SCALESIZE, SCALEFACTOR, SCALEAXES, SCALEEXTENT - at most one operator per request, applied to the subset-trimmed base grid), and phenomenonTime temporal subsetting (slice or trim against the coverage acquisition time; non-intersecting windows return InvalidSubsetting). Single-axis SUBSET fills the omitted axis from the stored raster extent only when the subsetting CRS is native; non-native SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS callers must supply both axes or use BBOX. Known unsupported WCS extensions return 501 OWS ExceptionReport XML; unknown GetCoverage parameters return 400.

knownLimitations: The route shape is layer-scoped: /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer.
Metadata, export, identify, tile, and statistics operate on the selected raster mosaic rather than a single primary raster.
Default exportImage responses return JSON with a temporary file URL; f=image returns rendered bytes inline.
Coordinate-selected Zarr exportImage currently emits native-CRS grayscale PNG with nearest-neighbor sampling only; transformed outputs are tracked by #2717.

Temporal mosaic uses newest-batch semantics: a time filter selects rasters from the single most-recent layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the requested instant before applying request geometry, so mixed-date scenes can leave spatial coverage gaps until per-pixel temporal mosaicking is implemented.
The query catalog reader applies WHERE/objectIds filters in-memory and reprojects footprint geometry to outSR when a coordinate transform is available.
computeStatisticsHistograms clips analysis to the supplied geometry envelope and executes Stretch, Colormap, and Clip renderingRule chains; ExtractBand, BandArithmetic, and pixelSize remain deferred.

exportImage and identify execute the renderingRule (Stretch MinMax/StandardDeviation/PercentClip with optional per-band Statistics; Colormap by explicit stops or named ColorrampName; Clip envelope/polygon including ClippingType=1 keep-outside; ExtractBand 0-based BandIds selection superseding the bandIds parameter), and the legend honours a Colormap renderingRule; identify with a renderingRule returns the rendered pixel (raw value otherwise); other stretch types, inline Colorramp objects, and extract-band-by-name are not yet honoured.
Legend swatches use a fixed 5-class equal-interval ramp; per-layer renderer persistence and renderingRule overrides are not yet wired up.
Service info exposes timeInfo when the layer metadata declares temporal fields or raster catalog items carry acquisition timestamps.
Rendered ImageServer byte output still depends on the PostGIS raster output drivers configured in the database.
WCS GetCoverage uses the selected layer's primary raster and opts out of exact response output caching for ad hoc coverage trims.

WCS GetCapabilities advertises the bounded transformable CRS set (each visible coverage's native CRS plus the default WGS84/WebMercator identifiers the CRS registry resolves), not the full spatial_ref_sys transformable set; the same set gates GetCoverage OUTPUTCRS/SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS validation.
WCS single-axis SUBSET fills the omitted axis from the stored raster extent only for native-CRS subsets; callers using a non-native SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS must supply both axes or use BBOX.

WCS Scaling extension factors (SCALEFACTOR/SCALEAXES) resolve against the subset-trimmed base grid in the coverage native CRS; for a non-native SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS the full native grid is used as the scaling base since the trimmed pixel span is not derivable in the adapter.

WCS phenomenonTime subsetting filters the primary raster's acquisition instant. A single coordinate-valued additional-axis selection on a readable registered Zarr coverage is served as a bounded native-CRS nearest-neighbor grayscale PNG; TIFF/JPEG, reprojection, advanced interpolation, and multi-coordinate trims are rejected explicitly.
hasMultidimensions is always false until cube ingestion ships; multidimensionalInfo remains absent.
ImageServer find filters by raster catalog footprint and returns catalog metadata; true camera/orientation-ranked image selection is deferred until sensor metadata is modeled.
ImageServer measure supports Basic map-space mensuration only; sensor/DEM-backed height and 3D mensuration are not implemented.
ImageServer tile GET storage is a loose-object cache, not an Esri compact cache or an advertised cacheInfo tile cache.

ImageServer exportTiles writes a flat ZIP (storageFormat=zip) or an Esri exploded-cache TPK (storageFormat=tpk/tilePackage=true) synchronously, or a Compact Cache V2 / TPKX package through a durable asynchronous job; the durable path requires an execution job store.

ImageServer WMTS supports GetCapabilities/GetTile/GetFeatureInfo for WebMercatorQuad image/png, image/jpeg, and image/tiff tiles with a TIME dimension for temporal layers; non-WebMercator matrix sets are deferred.

There is no /computeClass route. Raster-function chain validation is internal: a renderingRule chain is validated and planned as part of exportImage/identify/computeStatisticsHistograms execution (Identity/Stretch/Colormap/Clip/ExtractBand, max chain depth 8; unknown functions return 400, unsupported-but-recognized chains return 501). Esri has no computeClass operation either.

Generic GPServer adapter (#723) operates over the canonical process runtime. The built-in IProcessCatalog seeds 96 processes across geometry.*, analytics.*, overlay.*, proximity.*, statistics.*, surface.*, raster.*, conversion.*, generalization.*, data-management.*, import.*, transform.*, source.*, sink.*, gdal.*, and pcloud.* families for plan validation; heavyweight surface.* and raster.* workloads remain on the canonical worker/executor boundary (optional #727 executor adapters), and destructive data-management ids (delete-features, calculate-field) route through the operator approval gate before execution. Published task names currently mirror those built-in process IDs.

Generic synchronous execute route (#1660) is published for the deterministic single-geometry geometry.* / conversion.geometry-format family; those tasks run inline through the canonical job runtime (a protocol projection, not a separate engine). Heavyweight or layer-scoped tasks remain async-only and return a 400 capability message on execute that points at submitJob.
Canonical model and lifecycle state mappings are established in #360.

implemented.name: ClosestFacility solveClosestFacility
implemented.notes: Parses incidents and facilities into the canonical closest-facility request, ranks by network impedance, and materializes the closest routes through the configured IRoutingProvider.

implemented.name: Route solve
implemented.notes: GET query parameters and POST form parameters share one handler that parses stops, inSR/outSR, returnRoutes, returnDirections, barriers/polylineBarriers/polygonBarriers, and travelMode, delegates to the configured IRoutingProvider, and returns Esri route and directions feature sets.

implemented.name: ServiceArea solveServiceArea
implemented.notes: Parses facilities, defaultBreaks, inSR/outSR, travelDirection, barriers/polylineBarriers/polygonBarriers, and travelMode, validates provider-advertised travel-direction/barrier/mode support, and returns Esri saPolygons.

partial.name: LocationAllocation solveLocationAllocation
partial.notes: Implements minimize-impedance, maximize-coverage, and cutoff-required minimize-facilities over the canonical cost matrix. Minimize-facilities uses deterministic O(FÂ²D) greedy set cover with the standard H(D) approximation bound, cancellation, and configured input caps. Maximize-attendance, maximize-capacitated-coverage, maximize-market-share, and target-market-share are explicitly rejected because their required transformation, capacity, competitor, and attractiveness inputs are not modeled.

partial.name: ODCostMatrix solveODCostMatrix
partial.notes: Computes ranked origin/destination impedance cells through the canonical routing provider. esriNAODOutputNoLines preserves the cost-only fast path; esriNAODOutputStraightLines returns two-vertex polylines in outSR (the pgRouting provider batch-transforms all cells through PostGIS in one query). Providers without straight-line capability and true-shape modes return precise GeoServices 400 responses.

solve.name: barriers, polylineBarriers, polygonBarriers
solve.notes: Point, line, and polygon barriers are parsed from Esri FeatureSets and threaded into the solve; the pgRouting provider excludes the graph edges each barrier restricts (point = nearest edge, line/polygon = every intersecting edge). Providers that do not advertise a barrier kind return a GeoServices 400. Bounded by Routing:MaxBarriers. Supported on Route/solve and ServiceArea/solveServiceArea.

solve.name: travelMode
solve.notes: travelMode (bare token or Esri travel-mode object name) is validated against the selected dataset's verified travel_profiles metadata; unsupported modes return a GeoServices 400. Profile and column identifiers are validated and both impedance columns must exist. The selected forward/reverse columns drive Route, ServiceArea, ClosestFacility, OD matrix, and LocationAllocation. Existing datasets remain driving-only by default.

knownLimitations: Route solves accept GET and POST; the other NAServer solve operations are POST-only.
OD cost-matrix output is cost-only; line geometry remains deferred.
Location-allocation implements minimize-impedance and maximize-coverage; other problem types are rejected.
Network-dataset registry CRUD does not edit edges, vertices, turn restrictions, or rebuild topology.
The built-in dataset remains driving-only; non-driving profiles are available only when operators add real cost columns and register them in dataset metadata.
Unsupported provider capabilities (barrier kinds, travel modes, travel directions) return GeoServices 400 error envelopes.

implemented.name: List versions; version info
implemented.notes: Lists and resolves real versions from the version manager, filtered by the access policy (private versions are visible to owner/admin only). A non-visible version returns 404 rather than 403, so existence is not leaked; an invalid GUID returns 400. Providers without versioning return an empty list rather than an error.

implemented.name: Alter version; delete version
implemented.notes: Alter updates name/access/description; delete removes the version and returns 409 rather than deleting mid-reconcile/post. Both are owner-or-admin gated. The returned moment is wall-clock time, not a branch generation.

implemented.name: Reconcile; post; resolveConflicts; inspectConflicts
implemented.notes: Real reconcile/post over the Postgres version manager: conflictResolution/resolutionPolicy/abortIfConflicts and conflictDetection (including the Esri tokens) are honoured, withPost=true posts inline, and async=true returns 202 with a pollable job; lock contention returns 409 and an unsupported policy 400. inspectConflicts returns the pending conflict set with three-way base/DEFAULT/version images and per-field diffs; resolveConflicts applies per-feature {layerId, objectId, choice} resolutions. Providers without versioning return 501 rather than fabricating success.

implemented.name: Version job status
implemented.notes: Polls the durable job runner for an async reconcile/post; a job GUID belonging to another service or version returns 404.

partial.name: Service metadata
partial.notes: Returns a hardcoded descriptor (defaultVersionName "sde.DEFAULT", capabilities "Create,Delete,Alter,Reconcile,Post") after a service-read check only. It does not consult the provider's versioning support, so a non-Postgres store advertises five capabilities whose mutations then return 501.

partial.name: Create version
partial.notes: Creates a real version and maps a duplicate name to 409, but parentVersion is accepted and ignored (always null), so a version can only be branched from DEFAULT.

partial.name: startReading; stopReading; startEditing; stopEditing
partial.notes: Stateless acknowledgements: Honua holds no Esri edit/read session and issues no session token, because edits land per-request via gdbVersion rather than inside a server-held session. startEditing does resolve the version, return its durable branch generation as moment, and return 409 mid-reconcile/post; stopEditing has no saveEdits semantics (there is nothing to commit or discard). A client that depends on session tokens will not get Esri's behaviour.

knownLimitations: Every route in this service is capability-gated experimental (capability "versioning.branch") and returns 404 unless Capabilities:Experimental:versioning.branch:Enabled=true (or the global experimental switch) is set. The per-operation "maturity": "experimental" in the published matrix is derived from that capability descriptor, not hand-asserted. It is not part of the first-release surface.

implemented.name: OAuth2 authorize; callback
implemented.notes: Authorization-code + PKCE bridge that delegates the user leg to the operator's OIDC provider and returns an ArcGIS-shaped code. Opt-in: returns 404 until an OIDC provider is configured, and every redirect_uri is rejected until Authentication:PortalToken:OAuth2:AllowedRedirectUris is populated. PKCE is required by default.

implemented.name: OAuth2 introspect
implemented.notes: RFC 7662 introspection over opaque, JWT, and refresh tokens, admin-authorized. Off by default (EnableIntrospection → 404 when disabled). Emits active, sub, username, scope, token_type, and exp; client_id, iat, nbf, aud, iss, and jti are not emitted.

implemented.name: OAuth2 revoke
implemented.notes: RFC 7009 revocation for opaque, JWT, and refresh tokens; always returns 200 per §2.2.

implemented.name: OAuth2 token
implemented.notes: authorization_code and refresh_token grants with rotating refresh tokens (rotation on by default); Basic-auth client credentials accepted. POST only — the GET form was deliberately removed. The client_credentials grant is opt-in (EnableClientCredentials, default false → unsupported_grant_type), as is its optional IdP/OIDC federation.

partial.name: Group; createGroup; addUsers; removeUsers; delete group
partial.notes: In-memory, single-node, non-durable group overlay (lost on restart, not replicated). Group membership is never consulted by any read path, so it does not affect item visibility. createGroup accepts only title/description/access/tags and silently defaults an unknown access to private; snippet, phone, thumbnail, isViewOnly, isInvitationOnly, capabilities, and membershipAccess are ignored. addUsers/removeUsers ignore admins and return {success, groupId, members} rather than Esri's notAdded/notRemoved arrays. Private-group existence is not leaked; the owner cannot be removed; owner-or-admin gated.

partial.name: Community Self
partial.notes: Returns username and fullName from the caller's claims; role is hardcoded "org_user" rather than derived from RBAC, and Esri's groups array is absent (the group store is never consulted). id/email/orgId/privileges are not emitted. Anonymous callers get 401.

partial.name: Item; item data
partial.notes: Projects a graph service into an Esri item document; RBAC-correct (404 for unknown and for hidden alike, so existence is not leaked). owner falls back to a hardcoded "honua" when unauthored, and numViews/size/thumbnail/licenseInfo/ownerFolder/protected/appCategories are absent. The /data route currently returns the same item description document rather than the item's data payload (web map JSON / file bytes) — a known divergence.

partial.name: Share; unshare
partial.notes: Records sharing intent in an in-memory, single-node store that does not survive restart and is not replicated. It is write-only: no read path consults it, so sharing an item to everyone/org/a group does not change what /search or /content/items/{id} return for any caller — those project from the Metadata v2 graph and RBAC alone. Item existence is not validated, notSharedWith is always empty (group existence is never checked), and confirmItemControl, bulk items, and folder are ignored. Owner-or-admin gated.

partial.name: Portal Self
partial.notes: Only username and fullName are real (projected from the caller's claims). The portal id ("0123456789ABCDEF"), name, portalName, isPortal, and role are hardcoded; org settings, urlKey, allSSL, basemaps, and privileges are absent. Sufficient for client bootstrap, not for portal administration.

partial.name: Search
partial.notes: Honours q, start, num (capped at 100), sortField (title/created/modified/owner only) and sortOrder. The q grammar supports type:/owner:/tags:/id:/title: qualifiers plus free text; unknown qualifiers silently degrade to free text, and boolean operators, wildcards, and ranges are unsupported. bbox, filter, categories, countFields, and restrict are ignored. The item universe is FeatureServer/MapServer/ImageServer graph services only — web maps, apps, layers, and files are not items.

knownLimitations: Token issuance is the only Portal Sharing operation exposed in this slice. OAuth2 named-user, item editing, and the broader Portal item/group/community graph are tracked separately.
Tokens are opaque and carry no embedded claims; ClaimsPrincipal hydration occurs at validation time from issuer-stored state.
Default scheme remains API-key / OIDC; the PortalToken scheme is engaged by a bridge middleware only when the request carries a token indicator and no other scheme has authenticated.
